nodes.label: Q1: Resume, hold or retire AES
nodes.explain: AES canonical has been on hold since 2026-10-18 after the ~/code2 move to off-the-shelf tools. Should it stay on hold (kept as a working library two repositories still call), resume as a product, or be retired and archived? Recommendation: Keep it on hold. Run only the hygiene plan (docs/planning/next.goal.md) so the repository tells the truth about itself, and leave the aes CLI working for dodaf and whygame5. Default: AES stays on hold; agents run the hygiene plan and nothing else here.

nodes.label: Q3: Stale docstring wiki
nodes.explain: The durable-documents check fails with CATALOG-STALE because generated/docstring_wiki.md was not regenerated after later commits. Is regenerating it all that is needed? Settled by: An argument already settles the cause: regenerating in a scratch copy changes the counts from 1102 to 1098 tracked artifacts and 1061 to 1010 missing docstrings, so the file is simply behind the code. The fix is `make docstring-wiki` and a commit, then rerun the check; it is open only because this package touches docs/planning/ alone. Open as a work item only: the answer is known, and a check that still fails must point at an open question.

nodes.label: Q6: Evidence went stale after the commit rule's removal
nodes.explain: Decision 0010 accepted v0.2 with its nine criteria supported; `make aes` at 8b732aa reports 2 of 12 supported and 50 of 82 observations stale. Three criteria were added after the acceptance (SC-TR-001, SC-ADOPT-001, SC-TR-SOURCE-001), and 15 observations depend on commit_rule.py, which a06e963 deleted (docs and target updated in bb6818a). Is the staleness only that, or did a change break one of the nine accepted criteria? Settled by: Running the existing verification subjects settles it, no new evaluation: `aes evidence record <VS-ID>` for each deterministic-test subject behind the nine Decision 0010 criteria re-runs its named tests at HEAD; all passing means the evidence was only stale, and any failure is a regression with a named test. The three later criteria are listed separately with the evidence kind each needs: SC-TR-SOURCE-001 needs a trace_review (ER-TR-SOURCE-002) and SC-GF-001 a runtime_observation (a clean-user run), which re-recording tests cannot give. The unreachable accepted plan PLAN-AES-SELF-GOVERN stays a warning by design (reconcile.py lines 18-20).

nodes.label: Q7: 213 Markdown files, cap 140

Archive history out of the repository, or raise the limit with a new reason? Settled by: An argument settles it: the growth is proposals/ and docs/plans/ records of the commit-rule and enforcement work that the 2026-10-13 redirect ended, and the exception's own reason says limit growth should trip the check. Move the superseded plan bundles to ~/archive (after a content check, restore steps recorded) only where nothing cites them; raise the limit, with the count of cited files as its reason, for the rest. Open as a work item only: the answer is known, and a check that still fails must point at an open question.

nodes.label: Q17: Not in the code2 repository format
nodes.explain: ~/code2/AGENTS.md brings each repository into the code2 format when it is next changed; scripts/repo_format.py reports this one 0 of 1 compliant (missing docs/index.md, arc42, a .c4 model, OpenSpec specs, a code2check Makefile target). Does the hygiene plan adopt the format, or defer it? Settled by: An argument settles it: the rule applies when the repository is next changed, and the hygiene plan changes it, so the plan adds the items that cost minutes (docs/index.md pointing at wiki/index.md, a code2check target running make aes and the link check) and records the rest (arc42, .c4, OpenSpec specs) as deferred while AES is on hold, each with that reason.
